data.headline: Only $1.28 of $67 authorised has been spent; the immediate issues are $0.80 stranded on a revoked intent, a $10 unrestricted-merchant intent that has never paid anyone, and a cloud-infra intent whose per-tx cap is throttling every payment at 98%.

findings.title: Idle capital stranded on revoked trial intent
findings.detail: 0xe88b...df16 was revoked ('Trial ended, tool not adopted') after a single $0.20 payment, but $0.80 of the $1.00 funded remains on-chain and unspendable. This is pure recoverable capital with no offsetting reason to leave it.

findings.title: Active intent with unrestricted merchant allowlist and zero usage
findings.detail: 0x5682...2f5b ('General ops agent - discretionary spend') is Active with a $10 total cap, $2 per-tx cap and merchantAllowlistSize=0 / unrestrictedMerchants=true — the agent may pay any address. It has made zero payments in the window, so there is no operational justification for keeping an open-ended authority live. This is the largest containment exposure in the set even though the dollar figure is small.

findings.title: Cloud infra agent is being throttled at the per-tx ceiling
findings.detail: Both payments on 0x4e08...bcf4 landed at $0.49 against a $0.50 per-tx cap (98%), to the same merchant 0x1111. Repeated near-ceiling amounts indicate the cap, not the invoice, is setting the payment size — likely truncation or split payments. Total cap is also tight: $0.98 of $2 (49%) consumed on a weekly-recurring purpose with 30 days left, so the total cap will bind before the intent expires.

findings.title: Research subscription intent is over-authorised by ~500x
findings.detail: 0xb530...7ca7 carries a $50 total cap and $5 per-tx cap but has spent $0.10 across one payment (0.2% of cap, 2% of per-tx cap) to a single allowlisted merchant. The allowlist limits blast radius, but the standing authorisation is far larger than observed need.

findings.title: Portfolio-wide authorisation far exceeds demonstrated spend
findings.detail: $67 authorised across 4 intents against $1.28 observed spend (1.9% utilisation). All four payments carry receipts, so execution hygiene is fine; the problem is sizing, not accounting.

actions.rationale: Intent is already revoked and the tool was not adopted; $0.80 of funded balance serves no purpose and is recoverable immediately with withdrawRemainder.

A live $10 authority with an empty allowlist lets the agent pay any address. Since it has zero payments, there is no merchant history to grandfather in — set an explicit allowlist before it is ever used, or revoke it outright if no counterparty is known.

Two of two payments hit 98% of the $0.50 per-tx cap against the same allowlisted merchant, which means the cap is shaping payment size rather than bounding it. Raise the per-tx cap to the actual weekly GPU/storage invoice amount so payments are not split or truncated; the single-merchant allowlist keeps the risk contained.
$50 authorised against $0.10 spent (0.2%). Cut the total cap toward observed subscription cost to shrink standing exposure; per-tx spend has never exceeded 2% of the $5 per-tx cap either.

If the discretionary ops intent is kept rather than revoked, the $2 per-tx cap is 4x the largest payment ever made by this payer ($0.49). Size it to realistic ticket value alongside the allowlist fix.

dataGaps: All four payments occurred within a ~65-second span on 2026-09-13 despite a 90-day window — this looks like seeded or test traffic, so spend-vs-cap ratios may not reflect steady-state behaviour.
No merchant identities or labels; 0x1111/0x2222/0x3333 cannot be verified as the intended counterparties.
No expected or contracted invoice amount for the cloud infra intent, so the correct new per-tx cap for 0x4e08...bcf4 cannot be computed — only that $0.50 is too low.
No indication whether withdrawRemainder has already been attempted on the revoked intent, or whether the contract permits it post-revocation.
No funding schedule or top-up history, so it is unclear whether low fundedUsdc balances (e.g. $0.30 on 0x5682, $0.22 remaining on 0x4e08) are deliberate drip-funding or under-funding.
idleDays=0 on all intents including the revoked one, which conflicts with the presence of unspent funded balance; the idle-time metric may not be populated.

intents.purpose: Cloud infra autopay - GPU + storage, weekly
